world._about: The look of the room (task Д3; rebuilt to the Gemini picture of the whole room docs/art/gemini/raw/f1_room_v1.jpg, D138): pieces of the Night shop kit by grid cells, rect [x, y, w, h]; lamps hang on drop cells of cable from row ceiling, the lower face of the roof. The hall is 8 cells high over the upper floor; ground.roof: the solid rows above it, drawn as the dark roof. Numbers of the kit: world in look.json. Sizes follow the heroine (D112, docs/art/scale.md): a window 1.15x3 cells is 1.4x3.6 m, its sill a little above her head.

backdrop._about: The painted room (D131): one Gemini picture of the whole room in place of the kit pieces; back, front and ground are then not drawn. lit: the picture with the lamps' cones; dark: the same picture with the lamps off. rect: where it lies, in cells [x, y, w, h]. Under every lamp of lamps the lit picture shows through a soft cone as bright as the lamp is now (flicker, fall, Shift). cone: top_px the half width at the bulb, spread the half width it gains per pixel down, length_px how far down it reaches, soft the softness of its sides (0..1), above_px how far above the bulb it fades in. painted: nodes of the level whose still parts the picture already has; they draw only what moves (use_backdrop): the shutter's blade hangs up to clip_y (room px, the lower edge of the painted gearbox) and hides above it, its rack meshes with the painted gear at gear [x, y, size] and its wheel turns over the painted one at wheel [x, y, size] in room px. rect y -0.34: the picture lies 22 px higher than its cells so that the middle of its painted floors is where the hero's feet stand (24.11, level 01 notes); the lamps, the clock and the wire moved up with it; the exit's leaf covers the painted opening [x, y, w, h] in room px; the picture has the platforms' rail and chain, they draw only the plank and its gear. Every node of painted drawn by code takes the picture's light (kit_objects.picture_light in look.json).

quakes._about: Quakes of world time (Д4, D127): a weak one at 6 s, a strong one at 14 s that drops the third lamp and a lump of plaster beside it onto the treads of the stairs under them (rows 12.66 and 13.03: Stairs.tread_y), then weak ones every 13 s. Seconds are those of the WORLD timer. The look: kit_objects.quake in look.json.

world._about: Level 02 in the Night shop (same kit, height and scale as level 01, D112, D150, D164), 70 cells wide and 17 high, the roof on rows 0-1. Lamps: 0 over the start and button 1, 1 over pool 1's float, 2 over pool 2's float, 3 over the floor of the pipe room, 4 over the pit and the open flange, 5 over the slope and button 2 (it stutters when the pump fails), 6 over the pump room (stutters too), 6-7 over the tunnel, 8 by the exit.

Level 03 «Нить» in the Night shop (same kit and scale as level 01, D112), one screen of 30x17 cells, the roof on rows 0-1. The entrance floor (columns 0-8) with the winch over it; the pit (columns 9-13); the lower floor right of it with the lift (columns 15-16) and the steel mezzanine over it (row 10, columns 17-24, drawn by the level), closed by a wall at column 24; the cage's shaft (columns 25-26); the gallery with the exit (columns 27-29 from row 7). Lamps: 0 over the winch, 1 over the pit, 2 over the lift and the burner, 3 over the fire detector, 4 over the shaft, 5 by the exit. Objects (D178): ramp.keys: the winch's schedule, [world seconds, pose] (flat: a bridge over the pit; up: closed), the board turns smoothly between keys. lift: a once platform, waits delay_seconds (world seconds) at the floor, then rides up to the mezzanine at speed (px a world second) and stays. sprinkler: the fire detector's rain; rain_seconds (real seconds) it runs once a burning torch has come under the detector, spin_up_seconds to full rain.

collapse._about: The collapse of level 05 in three quakes (card docs/levels/05.md, D144; CollapsePlan). Act 1 counts from the room's start: the quake at quake_seconds, then each piece of act 1 falls 'second' after it (the platforms; the third breaks on its stub and crumble_seconds later crumbles into the pit) and each of 'lamps' of act 1 falls on its own onto row to_row. Act 2 begins when the heroine steps onto the crane: the second quake; after crane.delay_seconds it rides down its rail at crane.speed px per second and each of crane.lamps falls when it comes within lamp_lead_px of it. Act 3 begins when the crane reaches the end of its rail: the third quake; the crane sags sag_px over sag_seconds (tilting tilt_degrees) and falls at fall_second for fall_seconds; each piece of act 3 breaks off 'second' after the quake and goes to the bottom in fall_seconds (D149): 'sink' slides down evenly, 'drop' (the default) falls faster and faster, 'tumble' is a small chunk that drifts sideways, falls faster and faster and turns 'spin' times on its way (solid only above her feet, so she hits it but never stands on it); 'follow' hangs on a chain over pulleys against the piece 'follow' and rises as that one falls (D162); the pieces of act 3 are the first chunk by the rail, a wall hung on chains (it falls only after the slow part), a low chunk under it, a tumbling chunk, two steps, a heavy slab under the roof and the platform it hangs against, which rises from the last step to the exit ledge; the lamps of act 3 fall among them for their own fall_seconds, lit all the way down. The slow part of act 3: from_seconds after the quake the world's tempo eases down to 'tempo' over ease_seconds, holds until her step onto the exit ledge (D162), at most hold_seconds, and eases back. The heroine slows down too, to slow.heroine_tempo at the slowest (D148). blast: the explosion behind the falling ceiling at the third quake, at [x, row] in cells, burning 'seconds' of act 3's clock with a light radius_px wide, energy bright, of colour color (look only). Seconds of the world clock (D96).

world._about: Level 05 in the Night shop (same kit and scale as level 01, D112), 66 cells wide and 22 high, the roof down to row 4: the start floor at the left on row 17, three stubs in the pit for the platforms of act 1, the crane's ledge on row 11 on its pillar, the pit under the crane's rail open to the bottom (a fall is death), the exit ledge high on the right on row 9. Lamps: 0 over the start, 1-3 beside the platforms (they fall in act 1), 4 over the ledge, 5-7 over the rail (they fall as the crane passes), 8-9 between the chunks of the ceiling (they fall among them, shining), 10 by the exit. darkness: this room is darker than the kit.

Level 06 «Поток» in the Night shop (same kit and scale as levels 01 and 03, D112), one screen of 30x17 cells, the roof on rows 0-1 (D187). The high entrance floor (columns 0-5, top on row 8); tank A (columns 6-13, water rows 8-11, its float by the far wall); the wall between the tanks (columns 14-15, top on row 8) with the sluice at the bottom of A; tank B (columns 16-23, water rows 12-15, as wide and as deep as A, its float by the far wall); the exit floor on B's brim (columns 24-28, top on row 12). Lamps: 0 over the entrance, 1 over A's float, 2 over the sluice, 3 over B's float, 4 by the exit. The prelude's events open the sluice and run both tanks at 0.4 world seconds, so A runs into B on screen; tank_a/tank_b: full_seconds (world seconds) for the whole tank, lifts_player false (only a float carries her).
